g.text: Provisioning indicators, not measured utilization, power or billed cost
Bound cores = 6 + BDs × (workers + 3); allocation rounding/exclusive resources can be larger.
Bounce demand assumes one buffer per worker, not measured pinned allocation. GPU campaign allocated four GPUs in every cell; active GPUs vary.
